Terminology review (11 Nov 2026): tawqīfī renders توقيفية. In this passage the author connects it with ordered preparedness and higher/lower manifestations; the translation does not independently settle how that use relates to the usual doctrine of divinely authorized naming.
Announces philosophical objections to the human terminus of the existential movement.

The author’s next lemma is identified as addressing that reply; trailing punctuation marks are ellipsis fragments.

Dialectical-voice review (11 Nov 2026): this unit formulates objections, including a nested reply about universal cognition of particulars. These sentences must not be detached and represented as Ibn Turka’s final adjudication.
